svg.aria-label: DDR5 RAM price index pilot, day-one capture 2026-08-12 from named direct US retailers, Amazon excluded. Cheapest qualifying 32GB 2x16 DDR5-6000 kits: Corsair Vengeance $449.99 at B&H, Vengeance RGB $449.99 at B&H, Dominator Titanium $649.99 at Newegg — roughly 4x 2024 street prices. 546 listings reviewed, 21 qualified. Index activates at 6 of 12 kits. CC BY 4.0.
